The '''B-4D Legion''' was a model of [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] produced by the shipyards at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Primarily a drone bomber, the Legion utilized missile sentry drones, [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] to attack enemies, and was used by Imperial forces during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The B-4D Legion is one of the four bomber models available to Imperial players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 5,000 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Imperial faction's drone bomber, deploying repair, missile, and sentry drones. Its Republic counterpart is the [[Warcarrier]].<ref name="GS" />
